name: census-income
title: Adult Census Income (1994 US Census extract)
description: 32,561 person records from the 1994 US Census, the standard 'Adult' benchmark extract, with demographic and employment attributes and a binary income label. LICENCE: CC BY 4.0, as UCI publishes it; credit Becker and Kohavi (1996), https://doi.org/10.24432/C5XW20. Changes from the source: the '?' placeholder is NULL in three columns, the columns are renamed to snake_case, and the rows are sorted. Demo data: referenced by URL and built locally. Meridian does not host or publish this dataset. It describes individuals recorded in 1994 and is used here as a shape of data, not as a source of fact about anyone.

sources.title: Becker, Barry and Ronny Kohavi (1996). Adult [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5XW20

workclass.description: Employment sector. The source's '?' placeholder is NULL here — 1,836 rows.

final_weight.description: Census sampling weight ('fnlwgt'): how many people in the population this record is taken to represent. Not a property of the person.

education.description: Highest education level reached, as a label.

education_num.description: The same education level as an ordinal number, so it can be compared.

marital_status.description: Marital status as the 1994 Census coded it.

occupation.description: Occupation category. The source's '?' placeholder is NULL here — 1,843 rows.

relationship.description: Role within the household, as the 1994 Census coded it.

race.description: Race as recorded by the 1994 US Census, using that instrument's categories.

sex.description: Sex as recorded by the 1994 US Census, which offered two values.

capital_gain.description: Capital gains in nominal 1994 US dollars; zero for most rows.

capital_loss.description: Capital losses in nominal 1994 US dollars; zero for most rows.

native_country.description: Country of origin. The source's '?' placeholder is NULL here — 583 rows.

income.description: The benchmark's label, kept as the source's own '<=50K' / '>50K' strings rather than folded to a boolean.
